lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are organized into approximately four distinct horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, following the longitudinal axis of the torso.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, forming a regular grid where high-luminance circular clusters are situated at the nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance on the dorsal side to a shadowed trough below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the lower two-thirds of the fin's surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The region posterior to the first dorsal fin exhibits a jagged, truncated protrusion where the second dorsal fin would normally be located, indicating significant structural trauma or amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex network of caustic light patterns caused by surface water refraction creates high-contrast, non-static luminance overlays across the dorsal and lateral regions.
